validation.page_positive: Page must be a positive number
validation.limit_positive: Limit must be a positive number
validation.level_invalid: Invalid log level (INFO, WARN, ERROR, DEBUG)
validation.module_string: Module name must be a string
validation.search_string: Search keyword must be a string

list.description: Get a list of system logs with pagination and filtering. Supports filtering by level, module, search keyword and date range. Requires systemlogs.admin permission.

stats.description: Get an overview of system log statistics including total logs, logs in the last 24 hours, and distribution by level. Requires systemlogs.admin permission.

modules.description: Get a list of all modules that have created logs in the system. Used to display a dropdown filter in the admin panel. Requires systemlogs.admin permission.

levels.description: Get a list of all available log levels in the system. Requires systemlogs.admin permission.

response.list_success: Returns a list of logs with pagination information
response.stats_success: Returns an overview of system log statistics
response.modules_success: Returns a list of module names that have logged
response.levels_success: Returns a list of log levels

fields.module: Module name that created the log
fields.user_id: ID of the user who performed the action
